properties.entry: INSERT INTO ATTACHMENT ( FILE_NO, REF_BNO, ORIGIN_NAME, CHANGE_NAME, FILE_PATH, UPLOAD_DATE, FILE_LEVEL ) VALUES ( SEQ_FNO.NEXTVAL, (SELECT MAX(BOARD_NO) FROM BOARD), ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, 1 )
SELECT FILE_NO, REF_BNO, ORIGIN_NAME, CHANGE_NAME, FILE_PATH, UPLOAD_DATE, FILE_LEVEL, STATUS FROM ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = ? AND STATUS = 'Y'
UPDATE ATTACHMENT SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE FILE_NO = ? AND STATUS = 'Y'
